panels.title: Soleil = OK, nuage = attention, orage = alarme, lune = inconnu

targets.rawSql:
SELECT '/public/img/meteo/' || CASE niveau WHEN 'soleil' THEN 'Soleil.png' WHEN 'nuage' THEN 'nuages.png'
       WHEN 'orage' THEN 'orages.png' ELSE 'lune_dors.png' END AS icone,
       instance, niveau,
       CASE WHEN age_s IS NULL THEN 'pas encore relevé'
            WHEN statut = 'erreur' THEN 'relevé en erreur il y a ' || age_s || ' s'
            WHEN niveau = 'inconnu' AND age_s >= (SELECT valeur FROM meteo.parametre WHERE cle = 'peremption_s')
                 THEN 'dernier relevé trop ancien (' || age_s || ' s)'
            ELSE niveau || ' - relevé il y a ' || age_s || ' s' END AS texte,
       COALESCE(erreur, '') AS erreur
FROM meteo.etat_instance ORDER BY instance
